top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Romania Risks Losing €770 Million in EU Funds After Wage Law Failure
top_signals.summary: Romania is poised to lose about €770 million ($816 million) in recovery funding from the European Union after it failed to approve a unified wage law.

top_signals.title: Offshore Bondholders Emerge as Main Backers of Braskem’s Rework
top_signals.summary: International bondholders emerged as the main backers of Braskem’s $11 billion debt rework, which gave the petrochemicals giant another 90 days to hammer out a plan to balance its finances.

top_signals.title: Minutes of the Meeting of the Court of Directors held on 4 June 2026
top_signals.summary: The Bank's Court of Directors acts as a unitary board, setting the organisation's strategy and budget and taking key decisions on resourcing and appointments. Required to meet a minimum seven times per year, it has five executive members from the Bank and up to nine non-executive members.

top_signals.title: Personal Income and Outlays, June 2026
top_signals.summary: Personal income increased $54.9 billion (0.2 percent at a monthly rate) in June, according to estimates released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA). Disposable personal income (DPI)-personal income less personal current taxes-increased $48.3 billion (0.2 percent), and personal consumption expenditures (PCE) increased $65.2 billion (0.3 percent). Personal outlays-the sum of PCE, personal interest payments, and personal current transfer payments-increased $70.0 billion in June. Personal saving was $646.1 billion in June, and the personal saving rate-personal saving as a percentage of DPI-was 2.7 percent.Full Text

top_signals.title: You cannot be serious! Smashed John McEnroe racket set to be sold at auction
top_signals.summary: A tennis racket smashed by John McEnroe during one of his famous fits of rage is going under the hammer in an auction of sports memorabilia next month. The wooden-framed Dunlop Maxfly Fort mangled by McEnroe dates back to his heyday in the early 1980s, when the combustible American won multiple Wimbledon and US Open [...]

top_signals.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
top_signals.summary: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has issued a postmortem on a data leak in which a contractor published dozens of internal CISA credentials -- including AWS Govcloud keys -- in a public GitHub repository for almost six months before being notified by KrebsOnSecurity. Experts say the gaps identified in the agency's initial response provide important lessons that all security teams should absorb.
